device_entry.name: Voltech PM1000+功率分析仪
tags: 电力参数监测与能耗计量
device_entry.description: 用于电功率参数测量的台式功率分析仪，可在实验中对电压、电流、功率等电气量进行分析与读取。该设备通过 IEEE-488 接口进行仪器通信。
device_entry.description_en: A benchtop power analyzer for measuring electrical power parameters, used in laboratory experiments to analyze and read quantities such as voltage, current, and power. The instrument communicates via an IEEE-488 interface.

schema.description: 向功率分析仪发送查询命令并读取返回结果。
schema.description_en: Send a query command to the power analyzer and read back the response.
